title: Aries — Something Big Is Coming
script_text:
Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now.
Jupiter is now traveling through your 10th House, forming a powerful trine to your natal Sun, energizing your career ambitions and, as a true Fire sign, your passion ignites every opportunity. Meanwhile, Mars, your ruling planet, is squaring the Moon in the 7th House, stirring passionate tension in relationships.
If you're single, this fiery square draws magnetic, adventurous partners onto your radar, but stay grounded to avoid chaotic encounters; if you're taken, curb impulsive reactions to avoid unnecessary clashes.
Your 10th House benefits from Jupiter's trine to your Sun, boosting a promotion opportunity, while a quick review of your budget guards against careless spending.
Avoid reckless purchases that could drain your excitement—listen instead to the calm guidance of a trusted mentor who offers an unexpected breakthrough.
Follow for tomorrow's reading so you never miss the next cosmic update.
